name: Integrate WooCommerce with Lightspeed (Vend)
author: sujith222

sections.description:
This powerful integration plugin connects Lightspeed Retail (X-Series) with your WooCommerce store, offering:

✨ Free Features:
* Two-way inventory synchronization
* Simple product import
* Product updates from Lightspeed to WooCommerce
* Real-time order and customer from WooCommerce to Lightspeed

🌟 Premium Features:
* Automated product updates
* Automated inventory sync
* Lightspeed register selection for orders from WooCommerce
* Variable product support
* Lightspeed Brands integration
* Lightspeed Loyalty points tracking
* Priority support

Note: The premium features are only available in the Premium version of the plugin. You can get in touch with us or purchase from here: https://bit.ly/product-website

Limitations

  • Composite products are not currently supported (planned for future release)

The Integration

Steps:

  1. Click “Lightspeed Integration” on left menu in WordPress admin.
  2. Enter Lightspeed Subdomain, Lightspeed Personal Token and Lightspeed Cashier User ID and Click “Save Settings”(Detailed instructions are in the page).
  3. Now you will be able to import products to WooCommerce by clicking the button “Import products to WooCommerce”.
sections.installation:
This plugin requires you to have the WooCommerce plugin already installed and activated in WordPress. Otherwise you won’t be able to activate this plugin. It is recommended that you use this plugin in a staging environment before installing it on production.

From WordPress Admin

  1. Go to “Plugins” > “Add New”.
  2. Search for “Integrate WooCommerce With Lightspeed”.
  3. Once you find it click “Install” and after installing click “Activate”.

Manual

  1. Upload the folder “integrate-woocommerce-lightspeed” to /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through WordPress admin: Go to “Plugins” and click the “Activate” link corresponding to the plugin.

After Activation

Steps:

  1. Click “Lightspeed Integration” on left menu in WordPress admin.
  2. Enter Lightspeed Subdomain, Lightspeed Personal Token and Lightspeed Cashier User ID and Click “Save Settings”(Detailed instructions are in the page).
  3. Now you will be able to import products to WooCommerce by clicking the button “Import products to WooCommerce”.
sections.faq:
Is this compatible with the latest WooCommerce version?

Yes, we regularly test and update the plugin for compatibility with the latest WooCommerce releases.

How often does the sync happen?

Free version: Manual sync
Premium version: Automatic sync within a few minutes (configurable)

Does this plugin import all the products?

The free version of the plugin will import all the Simple products and the premium version imports Variable products too.

What about Variable and Composite products in Lightspeed?

Variable products are Premium feature. contact us here for purchasing: https://sujith123.wufoo.com/forms/z1xchp690scddy2/

Composite products are not currently supported.

Will WooCommerce work with my theme?

Yes, the plugin is not dependent on WordPress themes.

Where can I request new features?

You can use the form here: https://sujith123.wufoo.com/forms/z1xchp690scddy2/

Where can I report bugs?

Bugs can be reported in the support forum – Support link on the WordPress.org plugin page.
